JOIN pattern more efficient than EXISTS for larger result sets - query planner can optimize join order and use hash joins. Implemented React Router 7 intent-based prefetching with network awareness. Added prefetch="intent" to dashboard event card buttons and admin participant table links. Created useSmartPrefetch() hook that automatically disables prefetching on slow connections (2g/slow-2g) and when data saver mode is enabled. Lighthouse shows minimal changes vs POS-276: FCP unchanged (+1ms), LCP +9ms (within margin of error), Performance Score +1.0 (79.0 vs 78.0). Limited Lighthouse impact expected because prefetching benefits appear during NAVIGATION, not initial page load. Lighthouse only measures cold page load - cannot capture prefetch cache hits or instant routing experience. Real gains: hovering event cards/participant rows now prefetches route data, making subsequent navigation feel instant on adequate connections. Prefetch strategy respects user bandwidth constraints. Dev mode logging shows prefetch decisions based on connection quality. Expected impact: sub-100ms navigation times for prefetched routes vs 500-1000ms+ cold loads. Benefits most visible in user-facing navigation flows (dashboard → event details, admin → participant pages).
